_comment: Pterodactyl egg — Paper 1.21.x server ready for SecureAuth plugin. Upload SecureAuth-*.jar to /plugins after install.
name: Paper SecureAuth (1.21)
author: tienday
description: Paper 1.21.x Minecraft server. After start, put SecureAuth-1.0.2.jar into /plugins. Requires Java 21. Soft-depend ProtocolLib optional.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
MC_VERSION="${MC_VERSION:-1.21.4}"
BUILD_CHANNEL="${BUILD_CHANNEL:-default}"

echo "Downloading Paper ${MC_VERSION}..."
# Paper API v2
PROJECT=paper
VER_JSON=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MC_VERSION}")
BUILD=$(echo "$VER_JSON" | grep -o '"builds":\[[0-9,]*\]' | grep -o '[0-9]*' | tail -1)
JAR_NAME="paper-${MC_VERSION}-${BUILD}.jar"
curl -fsSL -o server.jar "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MC_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}"

echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
mkdir -p plugins
echo "Install done. Upload SecureAuth-*.jar into plugins/"
ls -la

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Paper version (1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.4, ...). SecureAuth api-version 1.21 → use 1.21.x preferred.
